0022600125.text: The Atlanta Hawks (2-1, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East) bring a 2-0 road record and a one-game losing streak into their fourth game of the season, while the Houston Rockets (3-0, 1st in the Southwest, 2nd in the West) are riding a three-game winning streak. In the season series, the Hawks trail 0-1 in 2026-27 so far, and they lost 0-2 in 2025-26, with their last meeting a 121-114 loss in Atlanta on October 24, 2026. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), both out, while Houston's Fred VanVleet (knee), Marcus Smart (forearm strain) and Steven Adams (ankle) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions.
